'''Anthelle Sharplyn''' is an [[Andoran]] noble of a minor House.

== Appearance ==
She is stout.

== Activities ==
She is one of the nobles to have thrown their support behind [[Elayne Trakand]] and has brought her armsmen to [[Caemlyn]].
